meta.description: Generate consensus sequences and manage reference files using samtools.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md
meta.n_inputs_note: Eight prior workflow classes were rerun as regressions and two fresh boundary cases were added, as required by the final-pass dispatch.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated scientific claims or citations were produced; all assertions use local synthetic data or the named public chr22 fixture.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill is a reference-file utility and makes no clinical or diagnostic claims.

methodological_ground.detail: The majority-vote implementation is explicitly pedagogical; tested consensus and reference-coordinate behavior matches the stated scope.

code_usability.detail: Copied current scripts executed in the documented WSL alignment-files environment; all runtime assertions in final_reference_operations.sh passed.

functional_suitability.note: Index, dictionary, extraction, consensus, and header-renaming routes are supplied and tested; the consensus CLI does not reject a wholly out-of-range window.

reliability.note: Scripts use strict shell handling and atomic final rename output, but the Python CLI returns an all-N sequence for an impossible window rather than a diagnostic error.

performance_context.note: The short SKILL routes detail to three focused references and two reusable scripts; reference operations necessarily retain several command examples.

agent_usability.note: Coordinate conventions, intended use, version context, and script invocation are clear; one boundary behavior is implicit rather than guarded.

human_usability.note: Natural requests for indexing, dictionaries, consensus, and contig renaming are covered with actionable commands and error clues.

security.note: No credentials are used and shipped shell paths are quoted; a hostile filename was processed without shell evaluation. Map-file contents remain trusted local inputs.

maintainability.note: Runnable logic is separated into named scripts and the references explain their limits; no shipped automated fixture suite accompanies the Skill.

agent_specific.note: The trigger is precise, references are progressively disclosed, related Skills are named, and pedagogical versus production paths are distinguished.

Derived dict is created beside hostile filename

key_strengths: Pinned scripts run in the documented WSL environment and keep reference-name changes separate from re-alignment.
The preparation script derives GATK-compatible dictionary names, surfaces bgzip constraints, and uses quoted paths.
The Python consensus tool preserves requested coordinate width; its real chr22 comparison reproduces the documented result.
Focused reference files keep the SKILL concise while retaining consensus-mode and contig-naming detail.

recommendations.title: Reject wholly out-of-range consensus windows
recommendations.problem: pysam_consensus.py consensus chr1 121 130 exits 0 and prints nine Ns even though the requested range is beyond a 120-base contig.
recommendations.root_cause: The CLI delegates range handling to pileup and does not compare START/END to the BAM header length before building its N-initialized output.
recommendations.fix: Before calling build_consensus, validate 0 <= START < END <= BAM reference length; exit nonzero with an actionable coordinate message. Preserve legitimate in-range uncovered columns as Ns.
